text:
riley: Heads-up — PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/432 landed into review but docs preview failed linkcheck and vale. Can someone pick a reviewer? I don't want to merge until preview is green. Logs: linkcheck found 3 broken links, vale flagged 2 rule violations (contractions + passive-voice).

.doc-ci-bot: Preview build #128 failed — linkcheck: 3 broken links (docs/migration.md:45 -> dead), vale: 2 errors (PR001, PR045), spellcheck: 1 (teh -> the). See CI logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/128

maria: I can take the link fixes. Quick triage: is the broken link the external API example in migration.md? If so I can update to the canonical host.

ken: I can handle the vale stuff. Most of it is passive voice flagged in the "Background" section. Small rewrite:

```
- The model was converted using the old toolset.
+ We converted the model with the legacy toolset.
```

ken: Also remove contractions to satisfy PR045 — replace "don't" -> "do not" in a few spots.

riley: Thanks. Maria, if you fix link + spellcheck can we re-run preview and then ken can push his edits? Scheduling wise: I'd like to merge before Friday's SDK freeze.

sam: Hold merge until staging-preview passes. We had a flake last week when linkcheck passed on CI but failed on staging due to relative path resolution. :eyes: 

maria: Will open a tiny PR with link fixes + typo fix ASAP. I'll add a note in PR description about the staging path difference.

ken: I'll run vale locally and push the style edits. Command I use:

```
vale --config .vale.ini docs/guide/migration.md
```

ken: Quick note — if anyone wants to reproduce the CI linkcheck locally:

```
python scripts/linkcheck.py --path docs --allow-internal
```

riley: OK plan: maria -> link PR, ken -> vale PR, then re-run preview. Sam will watch staging preview; if green before Friday we merge. Tagging @sam for staging watch.

sam: Got it. I'll watch the preview and report back.

doc-ci-bot: New preview triggered by maria's commit. Build #129 queued.

maria: PR up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/433 — fixed the two external links and typo.

riley: Thanks — everyone please review PR 433 + ken's when ready. If any blocker call it out here.

sam: Noted. If staging passes I'll merge both and do a quick smoke test on the examples page.

ken: Pushed vale fixes in PR 434. Short changes only.

doc-ci-bot: Preview #130 succeeded — all checks green (linkcheck, vale, spellcheck). :tada: 

riley: Merging now. Thanks team :rocket:
